name: Mini-Public on the Future of Agriculture (Vorarlberg, Austria)
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Like the other mini-publics led by this region, people were invited to participate from the random population based on representative criteria, but the amount of available information did not explain which ones were used exactly in the selection process.
